package.name: hri_context_analyzer
package.description: Context Analysis Module. Consumes the structured emori_msgs/Context and publishes standardised, REP-155-extension per-person context topics (/humans/persons/<id>/context/<key>) that any downstream behaviour or analytics module can consume. A channel is published only when it was actually observed, so a missing signal never reaches a plot as a confident zero; the reporting flags and the "not reported" sentinel are constants on emori_msgs/Context, readable with `ros2 interface show` and nothing installed. The fan-out rule itself (contracts.py) is pure stdlib Python and imports neither rclpy nor anything EMORI-specific. Open-source, Vulcanexus-compatible.
package.author: Pokamind AB
